newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Aug electricity demand rises 2.4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Aug electricity demand rises 2.4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Demand for electricity supplied by nine key Japanese power utilities in August rose 2.4 percent from a year earlier to 74.1 billion kilowatt hours (kWh), the Federation of Electric Power Companies said on Thursday.

Demand for household electricity rose by 3.1 percent from a year earlier, the federation said. Large-lot industrial demand fell 0.3 percent, decreasing year-on-year for the first time in five months, it said.
Electricity demand from paper/pulp companies remains strong, but demand from steel and electrical machinery makers is slow, it said.
